### Which file do I need?

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `Hoard-VERSION-macOS-Apple-Silicon.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `Hoard-VERSION-macOS-Intel.dmg` |
| Windows | `Hoard-VERSION-Windows-Setup.exe` (or `.msi`) |
| Linux | `Hoard-VERSION-Linux.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |
| iPhone, Android | no download: open [the web version](https://shevlukvasiliy.github.io/Hoard-English/) and add it to the home screen |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → About This Mac: "Chip: Apple M…" means Apple Silicon, "Processor: Intel" means Intel. The `.app.tar.gz` files are the same app without an installer; you don't need them.

Builds are not signed yet. On macOS, open Hoard once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**. On Windows, click **More info → Run anyway**.
